title: Recipe Page
prompt: Structure a recipe with a heading, ingredients list, numbered steps, and one image with a caption.
objective: Use semantic headings, both list types, and an image caption.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: headings, lists, images, sections.
hints: Ingredients are a group without sequence; cooking instructions are ordered.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.explanation: Reference approach: Ingredients are a group without sequence; cooking instructions are ordered. Required structural evidence: <h1>, <ul>, <ol>, <figure>.

grading_method: server-side required-string smoke check plus human review for quality
retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
